comparison.objective: Choose a zoom lens that retains 50 mm nose-down, mount and lock it from below, and set its zoom.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual lens alignment, insertion, mount locking, zoom-ring rotation, and friction-based selection versus hex-bit engagement, captive-screw locking, moving-socket reacquisition, and iterative impact tuning.
comparison.success_condition: Correct lens mounted, locked, released, and holding 50 mm under gravity versus two consecutive stops within dynamic and force limits with under-2-degree drift.
comparison.reason: This is the nearest rotary-setting/retention analogue, but it tests lens mounting and passive zoom retention, not feedback-based damper commissioning or fine fastener manipulation. No spec versions expose further rubric details.
